subject: English Language
assessment_title: English Language Grade 12 Term 3 Controlled Assessment Pack

visual_blueprint.subject: English Language
assessment_content_focus: integrated comprehension, summary and language structures
editing for grammar, diction, register and punctuation
formal transactional writing and controlled response planning
generation_constraints: Every question must be answerable from the stated term focus, supplied stimulus and grade-appropriate subject knowledge.
Educator approval is required before classroom use.

sections.title: Section A: Comprehension And Visual Literacy
sections.instructions: Read the supplied text and visual stimulus carefully before answering.
sections.stimulus: Source set on integrated comprehension, summary and language structures and cartoon, advertisement or infographic analysis. The educator inserts the approved text, cartoon, advertisement or infographic.

questions.question: Identify the main idea of the text and quote ONE piece of supporting evidence.
memo: Evidence is quoted or paraphrased from the source.

questions.question: Explain how tone and register shape the reader's response.
Analyse how the visual text uses image, layout and wording to communicate its message.
Write a 60-80 word summary of the key information.

sections.title: Section B: Language In Context
sections.instructions: Use the source text for language and editing questions.
sections.stimulus: Language focus: editing for grammar, diction, register and punctuation.

questions.question: Edit the supplied sentence for diction, punctuation and register.
Explain the function of TWO language structures used in the text.
Rewrite a sentence in a more formal register without changing the meaning.

sections.title: Section C: Writing Response
sections.instructions: Plan and write a structured response.
sections.stimulus: Writing task: formal transactional writing and controlled response planning.

questions.question: Write a transactional text with suitable structure, register and purpose.

rubric.descriptor: Answers are clear, complete and structured.

teacher_review_checklist: Confirm CAPS term and topic fit before classroom use.
Insert or approve final source material where the pack requests educator-supplied sources.
Check mark allocation, memo wording and learner level.
Confirm visuals are suitable and not treated as official source material unless sourced separately.
